ListSqlDatabases: SELECT name FROM sys.databases WHERE state_desc='ONLINE' ORDER BY name;
SqlDbSummary:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN mf.type_desc IN ('ROWS','DATA') THEN mf.size END) * 8.0 / 1024 / 1024 AS float) AS DatabaseSizeGb,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN mf.type_desc IN ('ROWS','DATA') THEN mf.size END) * 8.0 / 1024 / 1024 AS float) AS DataSizeGb,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN mf.type_desc = 'LOG' THEN mf.size END) * 8.0 / 1024 / 1024 AS float) AS LogSizeGb,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{db}}.sys.schemas) AS SchemaCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{db}}.sys.tables) AS TableCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{db}}.sys.views) AS ViewCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{db}}.sys.procedures) AS ProcedureCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{db}}.sys.objects WHERE type IN ('FN','IF','TF')) AS FunctionCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{db}}.sys.sequences) AS SequenceCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{db}}.sys.synonyms) AS SynonymCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{db}}.sys.triggers WHERE parent_id <> 0) AS TriggerCount,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{db}}.sys.indexes WHERE index_id > 0 AND object_id IN (SELECT object_id FROM {{db}}.sys.tables)) AS IndexCount,
  (SELECT MAX(STATS_DATE(object_id, stats_id)) FROM {{db}}.sys.stats) AS LastStatsUpdate
FROM sys.master_files mf
WHERE mf.database_id = DB_ID(REPLACE(REPLACE('{{db}}','[',''),']',''))
GROUP BY mf.database_id;
ListSqlTables: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, t.name AS TableName FROM {{db}}.sys.tables t JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id=s.schema_id ORDER BY s.name, t.name;
ListSqlViews: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, v.name AS ViewName FROM {{db}}.sys.views v JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON v.schema_id=s.schema_id ORDER BY s.name, v.name;
ListSqlProcedures: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, p.name AS ProcName FROM {{db}}.sys.procedures p JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON p.schema_id=s.schema_id ORDER BY s.name, p.name;
ListSqlFunctions: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, o.name AS FunctionName FROM {{db}}.sys.objects o JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON o.schema_id=s.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('FN','IF','TF') ORDER BY s.name, o.name;
ListSqlSynonyms: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, syn.name AS SynonymName FROM {{db}}.sys.synonyms syn JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON syn.schema_id=s.schema_id ORDER BY s.name, syn.name;
ListSqlSequences: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, seq.name AS SequenceName FROM {{db}}.sys.sequences seq JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON seq.schema_id=s.schema_id ORDER BY s.name, seq.name;
ListSqlTypes: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, t.name AS TypeName FROM {{db}}.sys.types t JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id=s.schema_id WHERE t.is_user_defined=1 ORDER BY s.name, t.name;
ListSqlTriggers: SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, tr.name AS TriggerName FROM {{db}}.sys.triggers tr JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON tr.schema_id=s.schema_id WHERE tr.parent_id <> 0 ORDER BY s.name, tr.name;
ListSqlIndexes:
SELECT s.name AS SchemaName, t.name AS TableName, i.name AS IndexName
FROM {{db}}.sys.indexes i
JOIN {{db}}.sys.tables t ON i.object_id=t.object_id
JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id=s.schema_id
WHERE i.index_id > 0
ORDER BY s.name, t.name, i.name;
GetSqlTableColumnMetadata:
SELECT 
  c.name AS ColumnName,
  ty.name AS SqlTypeName,
  c.max_length AS MaxLength,
  c.precision AS [Precision],
  c.scale AS [Scale],
  c.is_nullable AS IsNullable,
  c.column_id AS Ordinal,
  dc.definition AS DefaultDefinition
FROM {{db}}.sys.columns c
JOIN {{db}}.sys.tables t ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
JOIN {{db}}.sys.types ty ON c.user_type_id = ty.user_type_id
LEFT JOIN {{db}}.sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id = t.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id = c.column_id
WHERE s.name = @SchemaName AND t.name = @TableName
ORDER BY c.column_id;
SqlDependencyGraph:
SELECT 
  referencing_id,
  referenced_id
FROM {{db}}.sys.sql_expression_dependencies
WHERE referencing_id IS NOT NULL AND referenced_id IS NOT NULL;
ListSqlObjectsPaged:
WITH objs AS (
    SELECT 
        s.name AS SchemaName,
        o.name AS ObjectName,
        CASE 
            WHEN o.type = 'U' THEN 'Table'
            WHEN o.type = 'V' THEN 'View'
            WHEN o.type = 'P' THEN 'Procedure'
            WHEN o.type IN ('FN','IF','TF') THEN 'Function'
            WHEN o.type = 'SN' THEN 'Synonym'
            WHEN o.type = 'SQ' THEN 'Sequence'
            WHEN o.type = 'TR' THEN 'Trigger'
            ELSE o.type
        END AS ObjectType,
        o.create_date,
        o.modify_date,
        CASE WHEN o.type='U' THEN ISNULL(p.rows,0) ELSE NULL END AS EstimatedRows,
        CASE WHEN o.type='U' THEN CAST(ISNULL(a.total_pages,0)*8.0/1024 AS float) ELSE NULL END AS EstimatedSizeMb,
        dep.DependsOnCount,
        dep.DependedByCount,
        CASE 
            WHEN o.type IN ('P','FN','IF','TF') THEN 4
            WHEN o.type IN ('V') THEN 3
            WHEN o.type IN ('U') THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS ComplexityScore
    FROM {{db}}.sys.objects o
    JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON o.schema_id=s.schema_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT object_id, SUM(rows) AS rows
        FROM {{db}}.sys.partitions
        WHERE index_id IN (0,1)
        GROUP BY object_id
    ) p ON p.object_id=o.object_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            p.object_id,
            SUM(a.total_pages) AS total_pages
        FROM {{db}}.sys.partitions p
        JOIN {{db}}.sys.allocation_units a ON p.hobt_id=a.container_id
        GROUP BY p.object_id
    ) a ON a.object_id=o.object_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            d.referencing_id AS object_id,
            COUNT(DISTINCT d.referenced_id) AS DependsOnCount,
            (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.referencing_id) FROM {{db}}.sys.sql_expression_dependencies x WHERE x.referenced_id = d.referencing_id) AS DependedByCount
        FROM {{db}}.sys.sql_expression_dependencies d
        WHERE d.referencing_id IS NOT NULL AND d.referenced_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY d.referencing_id
    ) dep ON dep.object_id=o.object_id
    WHERE o.type IN ('U','V','P','FN','IF','TF','SN','SQ','TR')
)
SELECT 
  SchemaName,
  ObjectName,
  ObjectType,
  CAST(create_date AS datetimeoffset) AS CreatedDate,
  CAST(modify_date AS datetimeoffset) AS ModifiedDate,
  CAST(EstimatedRows AS bigint) AS EstimatedRows,
  CAST(EstimatedSizeMb AS float) AS EstimatedSizeMb,
  CAST(ISNULL(DependsOnCount,0) AS int) AS DependsOnCount,
  CAST(ISNULL(DependedByCount,0) AS int) AS DependedByCount,
  CAST(ComplexityScore AS int) AS ComplexityScore
FROM objs
ORDER BY SchemaName, ObjectName
OFFSET @Offset ROWS FETCH NEXT @Fetch ROWS ONLY;
SqlTableRowCount: SELECT SUM(p.rows) FROM {{db}}.sys.tables t JOIN {{db}}.sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id=s.schema_id JOIN {{db}}.sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE s.name=@SchemaName AND t.name=@TableName;
ListSqlSchemas: SELECT name FROM {{db}}.sys.schemas ORDER BY name;
